concept: Solid blue background, localized pastel chalk halo behind machine

prompts.cutout: Use case: background-extraction. Remove ONLY the dark navy background from this exact six-frame sprite sheet, replacing it with true alpha transparency. Preserve all six machines, every painted edge, interior dark trays, glass blue lids, court, buttons, ball, color, lighting and exact pixel placement and scale as closely as possible. Do not remove dark regions inside the machine. Keep same landscape 3 columns by 2 rows layout and aspect ratio 3:2, equal square cells, no repositioning, no cropping, no redesign. Only exterior background becomes transparent, no new shadows or props. This is for compositing the machine sprites over a painted halo.
prompts.halo: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: isolated soft pastel chalk-smear halo texture for layering BEHIND an illustrated tennis console. Square canvas, true alpha transparent background. Make a single compact irregular cloud of overlapping broad dry pastel strokes and wiped chalk residue: dusty lavender, muted periwinkle, pale mint, soft peach, very small buttery yellow accents. Texture like a chalkboard that has been wiped with a cloth leaving beautiful cloudy pigment ghosts, interrupted grainy streaks, semi-transparent scumbling, directional soft rub marks, uneven feathery edges and visible chalk dust. Art-directed hand-painted gouache/pastel look, NOT smooth digital gradients, NOT smoke, NOT neon glow, NOT circular rainbow, NOT ring. The center is a softly filled mottled wash, edges have several discernible curved broad wiped strokes. Overall softly irregular oval footprint occupying central 80 percent, clear transparent outer 10 percent margin. The texture is one cohesive soft backing glow to peek around a foreground object; no foreground object, machine, ball, lettering, icons, stars, emoji, sparkles, background surface or frame. Truly transparent exterior and semitransparent pigment strokes.
